review.notes:
Reviewer access:
Use the dedicated adult email/password account entered in App Store Connect Sign-In Information. Native Sign in with Apple is also available. Reviewer credentials and contact details are stored only in App Store Connect, not in source metadata.

Subscription:
1. Formie Monthly is the only plan offered: 10 analyses per month at the localized App Store price (US base price $9.99).
2. The native paywall shows the localized price, auto-renewal disclosure, Terms, Privacy, and Restore Purchases.
3. Apple controls purchase and subscription management.

Core review flow and AI consent:
1. From Home, start an analysis and select or confirm a catalog exercise.
2. Record a short set. Formie requests camera permission only and records without audio.
3. On the set-details screen, choose Review AI processing. Formie identifies the exercise video, declaration, and relevant profile information sent to Formie's servers and the paid Google Gemini API. Nothing is uploaded until Agree and analyze is selected.
4. Wait for analysis, then open the evidence-linked correction and saved progress. Consent can be withdrawn under Settings > AI Processing.

YouTube tutorials:
Eligible catalog exercises can show an attributed public YouTube tutorial selected with the YouTube Data API. Watch on YouTube opens the public YouTube page externally. Formie does not download or host the video, and tutorials do not consume analysis quota.

Coach Preview:
The Coach Preview tab is a deliberately nonfunctional static preview. It is not included in Formie Pro and exposes no chat or picker controls.

Account deletion:
Settings > Delete Account requires DELETE. Formie revokes or queues Sign in with Apple authorization and requests Gemini file and RevenueCat customer deletion before removing Formie data. Apple billing continues until the reviewer cancels it in Apple subscription settings.

en-US.title: Formie
en-US.subtitle: Video form coaching
en-US.description:
Formie turns a short exercise recording into focused, evidence-linked coaching. Record your set, choose the exercise and equipment you used, and review the moments that most affect your technique.

Each analysis explains what happened, why it matters, and what to do next. Corrections are tied to specific moments in your recording so you can understand the feedback and apply it on your next set.

Use Formie to:

- Record or review an exercise set
- See prioritized technique corrections
- Revisit the exact evidence behind each correction
- Track saved analyses and progress over time
- Manage Formie Pro from the app

Formie is an educational fitness tool and is not medical advice. Exercise within your ability and seek qualified guidance when needed.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
